title: や (and, among others)
meaning: "and (for example)" — an incomplete list of nouns.
simpleExplanation: や means "and" but with a hidden "among other things". 本やペン "books, pens and things like that". It tells the listener you are giving examples, not the full list. Compare と, which means "and" for a complete list. や often ends with など "etc." to make the incompleteness clear: 本やペンなど.
whenUsed: Describing what is on a desk, what you do at the weekend, which places you want to visit, what you bought: any time you name a few examples out of many. Nouns only.
formation: Noun + や + Noun + など  (本やペンなど)

rows.label: English
cells: there are a book and a pen
there are things like books and pens

examples.ja: 机の上に本やペンがあります。
examples.reading: つくえの うえに ほんや ペンが あります。
examples.en: There are books, pens and so on on the desk.
examples.note: Examples of what is on the desk (there may be more).

examples.ja: 週末は掃除や洗濯をします。
examples.reading: しゅうまつは そうじや せんたくを します。
examples.en: At the weekend I do cleaning, laundry and such.

examples.ja: 京都や奈良へ行きたいです。
examples.reading: きょうとや ならへ いきたいです。
examples.en: I want to go to Kyoto, Nara and other places.
examples.note: Examples of places: Kyoto, Nara and others.

examples.ja: 朝はパンや果物を食べます。
examples.reading: あさは パンや くだものを たべます。
examples.en: In the morning I eat things like bread and fruit.
examples.note: Examples of breakfast foods; the list is not complete.

examples.ja: 公園に子供や犬などがいます。
examples.reading: こうえんに こどもや いぬなどが います。
examples.en: There are children, dogs and so on in the park.
examples.note: や ... など: a classic pair.

similarGrammar.difference: と = complete list (only these). や = examples.
など = "etc." and follows the last item of a や list.
The verb version of や: "do things like A and B".

commonMistakes.wrong: 掃除をしたり洗濯や料理をします。
commonMistakes.right: 掃除や洗濯をします。／ 掃除をしたり洗濯をしたりします。
commonMistakes.why: や joins nouns only. For actions use たり〜たり.

commonMistakes.wrong: 父や母がいます。(meaning exactly the two)
commonMistakes.why: If you mean only those two, use と. や suggests there are others.

commonMistakes.right: 本やペンやノート ／ 本とペンとノート
commonMistakes.why: Do not mix と and や in one list; choose one type of list.

usageNotes: と = complete list (only these); や = partial list (these among others). Nouns only.
jlptTips: If など appears after the second noun, the blank between the nouns is や, never と.
The English translation in your head is not enough. Ask: "Are these ALL the items?" と for yes, や for no.
